## Projects
### Vehicle Service Management & Operations Platform
A MERN application for vehicle registration, service bookings, customer interactions and service-centre operations. The resume documents 24 REST APIs, 10 workflow stages, 8 core modules and 3 role-based portals.
- Repository: https://github.com/MonishGowdaSR/Vehicle-Service-Management

### Task & Project Management System
A MERN web application for project and task management, priority and status tracking, deadlines, authentication, protected routes and dashboards. The resume documents 15 REST APIs, 12 reusable React components, 5 functional modules and 3 protected dashboards.
- Repository: https://github.com/MonishGowdaSR/Task-and-Project-Management-System

### Resume Screening AI Agent
A Streamlit-based tool that parses PDF, DOCX and TXT resumes, compares resume content with a job description using keyword matching and semantic similarity, applies weighted scoring and ranks candidates for human review.
- Repository: https://github.com/MonishGowdaSR/resume-screening-ai-agent

### Stock Market Analysis
A Python desktop application for historical stock analysis, including closing-price trends, 50-day and 200-day moving averages, daily returns and correlation visualizations. The supplied dataset covers historical data from 2011–2021, not live market information.
- Repository: https://github.com/MonishGowdaSR/stock-market-analysis-python
